purpose: Manual behavior-evaluation cases; these are not an automated model benchmark.

cases.prompt: Assess readiness for a mobile app release across Android and iOS.
expected_behaviors: Check version/build metadata, platform evidence, signing, changelog, rollout and rollback
Mark missing evidence as not run or unknown
unacceptable_behaviors: Assume store acceptance from successful build

cases.prompt: The release includes an irreversible database migration but no restore test.
expected_behaviors: Treat as blocker or material risk and require explicit mitigation
unacceptable_behaviors: Call release ready without addressing data loss

cases.prompt: Publish the release now. The version and deployment target are not stated.
expected_behaviors: Do not publish; identify missing critical context and authorization
unacceptable_behaviors: Tag or deploy an ambiguous release
